I ran every query below against its data file and it gave a plausible answer. I didn't check the answers against any expected values. In Y12 and Y13 I added a `toKeyword` or `toString` conversion where a string key was needed, and the map keys print as keywords.

Y1: 3
Y2: `["corp.io" "example.com" "mail.org"]`
Y3: 31.5
Y4: `{:ann 2 :unassigned 2 :bob 1 :cy 1}`
Y5: `[106 101 104]`
Y6: `["express" "jest" "typescript" "zod"]`
Y7: `{:name "demo-app" :major 2 :depCount 7 :hasTest true}`
Y8: `{:db 3 :api 1 :auth 1}`
Y9: `["api" "auth" "cache" "db"]`
Y10: 333.77
Y11: `[{:customer "Beta" :total 23} {:customer "Acme" :total 15}]`
Y12: `{:web 3000 :api 8080 :cache 6379 :metrics 8080}`
Y13: `{:host "localhost" :port "5432" :user "admin" :ssl "true"}`
Y14: `[{:word "the" :count 3} {:word "dog" :count 2} {:word "fox" :count 2}]`

Y1: get /data/users | map ~(query /profile/country) | filter ~(ne null) | map ~(lower) | filter ~(eq "de") | count
Y2: get /data/users | map ~(query /email) | filter ~(ne null) | map ~(split "@" | get /-1 | lower) | toSet | sort
Y3: get /data/users | filter ~(get /active | eq true) | map ~(query /profile/age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 1
Y4: filter ~(get /status | eq "open") | map ~(query /assignee | if (eq null) ~("unassigned") ~(it)) | groupBy | map ~(count)
Y5: map ~(get {:id /id :n ~(query /comments [] | count)}) | sort ~(get [~(get /n | desc) /id]) | take 3 | map ~(get /id)
Y6: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | reduce [] ~(concat) | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString) | toSet | sort
Y7: get {:name /name :major ~(get /version | split "." | get /0 | toNumber) :depCount ~(get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(keys) | reduce [] ~(concat) | toSet | count) :hasTest ~(get /scripts | has /test)}
Y8: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | eq "ERROR") | map ~(get /2) | groupBy | map ~(count)
Y9: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(get /1 | anyOf ~(eq "WARN") ~(eq "ERROR")) | map ~(get /2) | toSet | sort
Y10: lines | filter ~(ne "") | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | map ~(get {:c /1 :q ~(get /3 | toNumber) :p ~(get /4 | toNumber) :s ~(get /5 | lower)}) | filter ~(get /s | eq "paid") | map ~(mulOf /q /p) | sum | round 2
Y11: lines | filter ~(ne "") | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | map ~(get {:c /1 :q ~(get /3 | toNumber) :s ~(get /5 | lower)}) | filter ~(get /s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy /c | map ~(map ~(get /q) | sum) | entries | map ~(get {:customer ~(get /0 | toString) :total /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /total | desc) /customer]) | take 2
Y12: get /services | entries | filter ~(get /1 | query /enabled true | ne false) | map ~(get [~(get /0) ~(get /1 | query /port | if (eq null) ~(8080) ~(it))]) | toMap
Y13: lines | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") | map ~(split "=") | map ~(get [~(get /0 | trim | split "_" | drop 1 | join "_" | lower | toKeyword) ~(get /1 | trim)]) | toMap
Y14: "the Quick brown fox jumps over the quick Dog and the lazy dog Fox" | split " " | map ~(lower) | groupBy | map ~(count) | entries | map ~(get {:word ~(get /0 | toString) :count /1}) | sort ~(get [~(get /count | desc) /word]) | take 3
